title: ochyrorchis pectinata
intro: Ochyrorchis pectinata, commonly known as the Chinese orchid, is a type of flowering plant. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine, where its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to improve cardiovascular health and reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Ochyrorchis pectinata include cardiotonic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-arrhythmic effects, which may help to regulate heart rate and blood pressure. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
